sources.title: llmware/qwen3-4b-instruct-gguf · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: qwen3-4b-instruct-gguf qwen3-4b-instruct-gguf is a GGUF Q4_K_M int4 quantized version of Qwen3-4B-Instruct, providing a very fast inference implementation, optimized for AI PCs. This is from the latest release series from Qwen, and has 'thinking' capability expressed as 'think' tokens. This model will run on an AI PC with at least 16 GB of memory.

sources.title: Qwen3-4B-GGUF: Efficient 4B Language Model for Local Inference ...
sources.snippet: Deploy Qwen3-4B-GGUF locally with thinking/non-thinking modes, 131K context, and 100+ language support. Apache 2.0 licensed. Full evaluation, hardware needs, and commercial use guidelines.

sources.title: Qwen3-4B: Private Reasoning LLM for Ops Automation
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B is a 4-billion-parameter causal language model from Alibaba that switches between extended-reasoning and fast-inference modes within a single forward pass, natively supporting 32K context (131K with YaRN scaling).

sources.title: Qwen3-4B-GGUF: Efficient Quantized LLM with Thinking Mode ...
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B-GGUF is a 4B open-source language model with reasoning (thinking) and dialogue modes, 100+ language support, and GGUF quantization for CPU/low-VRAM inference. Apache 2.0 licensed, served by Unsloth.
